status: Investigation of system resets during a candidate driver trial. The record describes exposure and observed execution boundaries.

source_changes.runtime: Remove the process-environment early return from video_adapter_init. The existing adapter callback, GM20B NVDEC resources and client checks, and 128000-byte firmware verification then run for eligible processes. An eligible adapter offers the D3D11.1 interface through GetSupportedVersions.
source_changes.hardware_start: The adapter query copies the start-time KMD resource/client snapshot. Firmware upload to the engine starts in CreateVideoDecoder; capability discovery reads and verifies the firmware on the CPU.
source_changes.other_source: The ARM64 test fixture stops setting the video opt-in. The package updater accepts a default-enabled UMD and clears obsolete selection metadata.

prior_kernel_change.scope: A high-resolution one-shot timer polls pending GPU fences. The unchanged signed kernel was used in both comparison arms.

source_changes.presentation_hypothesis: CreateDevice prepares the runtime-device NVK submission transport for the Win7 DDI, and for a D3D11.1 video device only with the separate window diagnostic request. Ordinary D3D11.1 callers can negotiate a different path. Existing resource contract tests demonstrate a displayable-resource failure without runtime-queue ownership. The UMD hash loaded by DWM identifies the binary; it does not identify the DDI selected by DWM or prove the cause of a system reset.

previous_umd_restart.note: This unplanned restart preceded staging the candidate. The prior Edge playback used software and had already exited.

first_three_candidate_transitions.evidence: The native executable reported startup, enumerated the Tegra adapter and entered the UMD identity output. The retained text ends mid-line. No verified frame or exit was captured.
first_three_candidate_transitions.stdout_prefix:
START pid=368 session=1
RETURN CreateDXGIFactory1=0x00000000
RETURN Find native adapter=0x00000000
RETURN Describe adapter=0x00000000
LOADED_U

first_three_candidate_transitions.evidence: Windows acknowledged the task. The test directory survived empty. Native client execution, decoder creation and frames are unverified.

The first marker used an ambiguous six-argument FileStream constructor in Windows PowerShell 5.1 before the Start-Process statement. The identical marker failed in a software-only replay, and the unchanged reference launcher returned task result 1 while Windows stayed on the same boot. The assigned workload cannot be credited with starting the decoder.

paired_decode.method: Same signed ARM64 executable, Tegra adapter selected by LUID, hardware kernel, desktop ICD, clip and six-frame reference. Each headless video fixture ran in the interactive session with decode-only and UMD hash verification. Both controls set the historical environment variable in the child only; the candidate has no reader for it. No video-window override. Caller journal and stdout were streamed over the same SSH controller to persistent host storage.

current_evidence.connection_observation: The host lost transport. A postincident OS boot ID is required to distinguish reset, hang and lost networking.
current_evidence.registered_umd_vs_client: The candidate was verified in DWM and the registered file. Its test process lost transport before the loaded-module proof returned.
current_evidence.uncontrolled: Separate boots, background scheduling, temperature and instantaneous clocks. One paired completion provides no failure-rate estimate.
current_evidence.diagnosis: A longer post-disconnect interval on the LAN remained unavailable. The workload checkpoint is host-persisted. Postincident OS state and physical restoration of the reference package remain unverified.

older_controls.trace_coverage: The KMD and tgd3d providers used all event IDs at the chosen keyword; the separate DxgKrnl provider used an event-ID filter. Aborted captures have no final buffers. Polling at a fence is also visible in the control where Windows continued.
older_controls.desktop_render_comparison: With the same llvmpipe DLL, the verified Code 43 BasicDisplay run reached the PAL4 menu and closed. The Code 0 desktop trial restarted. Their power mode and EMC frequency differed.
older_controls.cpu_control: The matched prior PAL4 trials varied the CPU voltage/frequency together. One boot restarted at 1497.6 MHz, another returned a game exception at 998.4 MHz, with fixed GPU/EMC settings.
older_controls.additional_cases: The full game archive extraction and a desktop logon also have unclean-boot records. A second 7353-file archive completed six verification passes. These cases do not establish a common hardware fault.

prior_watchdog_dumps.classification: Prior Windows video-engine-timeout live dump; parameter 2 falls in tegragpurender.sys. It predates all the current boots. The current event 41 records contain bugcheck zero and there is no matching new dump.

decision: The original opt-in removal remains a candidate. The previously accepted baseline corresponds to the reference UMD. The latest retained failure boundary precedes the H.264 file-open call in the fixture; the underlying reset mechanism and the link to all previous incidents remain open.
